description: Integration daemon that wires the existing temporal_stability_enrichment.py into the signal pipeline. Polls mcp_server_registry for MCPs without a temporal_stability score in mcp_signal_enrichments, calls temporal_stability_enrichment.compute_score(metadata) per MCP, and writes results to mcp_signal_enrichments with signal_type='temporal_stability', confidence, evidence_blob. Target: move temporal_stability from current 4 distinct values (weak discrimination) toward 20+ distinct values across the 34-fingerprint corpus. Uses write_service :8772 for all DB operations. Heartbeat every 60s to service_health.
